supporting_observations.claim: A large outbound transfer of approximately 640 MB was observed from FILE-NWD-01 to PROXY-NWD-01 (10.40.20.30) on port 8080 at 13:45 UTC.
The outbound transfer is consistent with the approved StratoSafe backup service, which is known to upload several hundred MB from FILE-NWD-01.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon logs for FILE-NWD-01 were not collected between 13:30 and 14:10 UTC due to a log collection outage.
claims_not_established: The specific process on FILE-NWD-01 that initiated the transfer cannot be confirmed via logs due to the collection outage.
unrelated_findings: Nora Blake (help desk) accessed FILE-NWD-01 via RDP at 13:34 UTC (T040-00103), which deviates from the organization's policy that remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01.
An attempt to disable Real-Time Monitoring in Windows Defender was observed on FILE-NWD-01 at 14:17 UTC (T040-00457).
